title: Terminal & Shell
motto: The terminal is where AI engineers live. Get comfortable here.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: The terminal is where AI engineers live. Get comfortable here.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You will spend more time in the terminal than in any editor. Training runs, GPU monitoring, log tailing, remote SSH sessions, environment management. Every AI workflow touches the shell. If you're slow here, you're slow everywhere.
This lesson covers the terminal skills that matter for AI work. No history of Unix. No deep-dive into Bash scripting. Just what you need.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: The shell is how you orchestrate training jobs, tail logs, and SSH into GPUs. Pipes chain commands; env vars configure runs.
